title: Dress in Unreal
author: MMPhotoshop
selftext:
I have been developing a video game for a couple of months now. While this is my third project, I have never previously had to deal with clothing for my characters.



I have always found it extremely difficult to outfit characters. I have even looked into tools from Epic to help simplify the process.



Currently, my workflow is as follows:

1. I provide a description to ChatGPT to generate the design for the outfit I want.

2. I use the website Tripo3D to create a 3D version of the outfit.

3. I then refine the outfit manually in Blender.

4. I have codex insert the dress onto the base character in T pose (takes 30 minutes in GPT 5.6 sol mode).

5. Afterward, I have to verify that the outfit fits correctly; I use a piece of software within Blender to make adjustments.

6. If that software fails to fix the fabric, I have "GPT 6 Astra" (or "sol") attempt to repair the seams.

7. If that still doesn't work, "GPT 5.6 sol" has to recreate the outfit from scratch, and the whole process begins again.



Creating a single outfit can take days.



The game features a procedurally generated city that I have detailed extensively, allowing players to enter every house and every room. The issue, however, lies with the characters who inhabit this city; I currently cannot add any characters because I am unable to get their clothing to fit properly.



If you have a method, even by hand (because the AI isn't suggesting anything useful to me) that works in less than 1 hour, I thank you infinitely.
